claim_statement: Baseline Train H C3MR Total Compressor Shaft Power is ~100.05 MW (mean) / 108.06 MW (P90).
evidence_source: DCS steam telemetry (H4FI031A+29A+30A = 484.7 t/h / 4.04 = 119.9 MW total driver; HYSYS shaft = 108.06 MW).
applicability_boundary: Entire active operating population (110,137 minutes, P1 to P100).

claim_statement: Direct MCR Compression Power Reduction (4K-2 LP + 4K-3 HP) is 10.83 MW at P90 and 4.14 MW annual empirical DCS holdout.
evidence_source: HYSYS Table 03_COMPONENT_POWER_FINAL.csv (78,173.93 -> 67,347.84 kW) & DCS SLSQP 100-percentile run.
validation_metric: Field Delta = 4.37 t/h steam (4,143.8 kW shaft); Model Delta = 4.32 t/h steam.
applicability_boundary: P1 to P100 under safe surge floor (480.0 t/h) and TAL interlock (>= -45.0 °C).

claim_statement: 4KT-1 Propane Turbine Speed is physically constant at ~3,000 RPM (3,040 ± 39 RPM) and not re-governed by operators.
evidence_source: DCS Tag H4SI018A across 707,142 records (P10 = 2,998.9 RPM, P90 = 3,098.6 RPM, CV = 1.3%).

claim_statement: Case A Achievable Field Saving reduces steam by 34,297.4 t/yr, saving 2.72M Nm³ fuel gas and USD 291.5k/yr.
validation_metric: Weighted steam reduction = 4.37 t/h; DCS fuel gas ratio = 79.33 Nm³/t.
applicability_boundary: Current plant DCS control logic without modifying governor loops.

claim_statement: Case B Advanced Control Modification saves 11.35 MW to 15.33 MW shaft power and 94,042 t steam/yr.
evidence_source: Coupled MCR + Propane flowsheet under validated OEM Dresser-Rand 939B6/4 surge buffer (SM >= 8.0%).
validation_metric: Direct MCR saving (10.83 MW) + Bounded Propane saving (4.50 MW) = 15.33 MW at P90.
applicability_boundary: Requires re-tuning 4KT-1 governor and modifying DCS control loops.

claim_statement: Theoretical boiler fuel gas savings of 97.70 Nm³/ton steam.
validation_metric: Assumes LHV = 33.10 MJ/Nm³ and boiler efficiency = 85.0%.
applicability_boundary: Benchmark comparison only; actual measured ratio is 79.33 Nm³/ton.

claim_statement: Unconstrained 28.98 MW (27.10%) C3MR shaft power saving is achievable under current operations.
evidence_source: Audit finding: 18.15 MW of this claim came from unconstrained 4K-1 propane credit violating OEM surge limits.
validation_metric: Throttling 4K-1 by 60.7% violates surge margin (SM drops < 0%).
applicability_boundary: Retired. Reclassified as unconstrained theoretical potential.

claim_statement: Historical MCR composition remained static and frozen across all production loads.
evidence_source: Refuted by 2,531 shift-level laboratory GC samples in OverallComposition_2023_2024.xlsx.
validation_metric: C3 varied from 0.00% to 10.11%; C1 varied from 39.10% to 52.67%.
applicability_boundary: Retired. Replaced by dynamic ILR medoid modeling.
